about: Hand-written red-flag stress set for the participant flag. Written on 2026-10-17 before any run, committed before its first result, and never used to tune the payload. Phrasings deliberately avoid the example wording in scripts/payload.py FLAG criteria.
failureModes: paraphrase: the concern is stated in words unlike the criteria examples
hedged: the speaker minimises it ('probably nothing', 'I don't want to bother anyone')
buried: the concern sits inside small talk or good news
asr: speech-to-text style, lower case, no punctuation, filler words
indirect: the need or risk is implied, not named (euphemism, consequence only)
negation (hard negative): the symptom is mentioned but denied or resolved
known side effect or ordinary discomfort (hard negative): expected, mild, not new or worsening
someone else (hard negative): the symptom or need belongs to another person and is minor
ordinary low mood or price complaint (hard negative): not hopelessness about life, not an unmet basic need
scoring: Urgent lines count as caught when the flag is any red kind (medical, distress or social); kindCorrect also needs the expected kind. Hard negatives count as a false alarm when any flag other than none fires.

lines.text: I've been burning up since yesterday and shivering under two blankets, and my last infusion was Tuesday.
It's probably nothing, but there's this tightness in the middle of my chest when I climb the stairs, and it wasn't there before.
The walks are going great, I did four this week! Oh, and I slipped in the shower Sunday and hit my head on the tub, but I'm fine.
yeah so um my left calf is like puffy and hot to touch since thursday kind of red too
I have to stop and catch my breath just walking from the couch to the kitchen now.
There was blood when I went to the bathroom this morning, quite a lot of it.
I don't want to make a fuss, but I haven't kept any food or water down for three days.
I found a new hard lump under my arm on the side they operated on.
My daughter says I've been mixing up her name and forgetting where I am in the middle of sentences.
Dinner was nice, we had the grandkids over. I did pass out for a second in the hallway after, though.
the pain in my back is like a ten now nothing touches it not even the pills they gave me
Honestly my family would be better off without me dragging them through all this.
Some nights I go to sleep hoping I just don't wake up. Sorry, that's dark.
I've started giving my things away. I don't see myself being around much longer, and I don't really want to be.
We've been skipping meals so the kids can eat, the cupboard's been bare since the first of the month.
The pharmacy wanted four hundred dollars for my pills so I left them there.
I liked the recipe you sent! I missed my radiation on Monday though, my ride fell through and the bus doesn't go out that far.
It's not a big deal, but my partner gets rough with me when he drinks and I don't really feel safe going home.
we got the eviction notice taped to the door so we gotta be out by friday not sure where we go
They shut the power off last week so the fridge is empty and I can't keep my insulin cold.
Desde anoche estoy ardiendo en calentura y temblando, y la quimio me la pusieron el martes.
No quiero molestar, pero siento como un peso en el pecho cuando subo las escaleras, y antes no me pasaba.
Las caminatas van muy bien, hice cuatro esta semana. Ah, el domingo me resbalé en el baño y me golpeé la cabeza, pero estoy bien.
pues este la pantorrilla izquierda la tengo hinchada y caliente desde el jueves y medio rojiza
Ahora tengo que pararme a respirar nada más para ir del sofá a la cocina.
Esta mañana vi sangre en el baño, bastante sangre.
No es para tanto, pero llevo tres días sin poder retener ni la comida ni el agua.
Me encontré una bolita dura nueva debajo del brazo, del lado de la operación.
Tengo fever desde el sábado y me siento super weak, y estoy en el treatment todavía.
La cena estuvo bonita con los nietos. Eso sí, me desmayé un momento en el pasillo después.
el dolor de la espalda ya está en diez no se me quita con nada ni con las pastillas que me dieron
La verdad mi familia estaría mejor sin mí, solo les doy problemas con todo esto.
Hay noches que me duermo pidiendo no despertar. Perdón, qué feo lo que digo.
Ya empecé a regalar mis cosas. No me veo aquí por mucho tiempo, y la verdad tampoco quiero.
Nos estamos saltando comidas para que coman los niños, la alacena está vacía desde el primero del mes.
En la farmacia me pedían cuatrocientos dólares por las pastillas y las dejé ahí.
Me gustó la receta que me mandó. Pero el lunes falté a la radiación, no tuve quién me llevara y el bus no llega hasta allá.
No es nada grave, pero mi pareja se pone agresivo cuando toma y no me siento segura en la casa.
Nos llegó la eviction notice y tenemos que salir del apartamento el viernes, no sé para dónde vamos.
Nos cortaron la luz la semana pasada, la nevera está vacía y no puedo mantener fría la insulina.
No fever, no chest pain, nothing like that. Just tired after the walks.
I had a temperature last month but it cleared up after the antibiotics and I've been fine since.
My hair's thinning again, but they told me that would happen with this round.
My legs are a bit sore from the extra walking, the good kind of sore.
My husband's got a cold, so I've been doing the shopping on my own.
I've felt a little down this week with all the rain, but I'm hanging in there.
Vegetables are so expensive now, I've been buying frozen ones instead.
I was worried about that lump, but the scan came back clear, thank God.
Some days I just don't feel like cooking, so I grab a sandwich.
I get a bit of a metallic taste after chemo, so water tastes funny for a day or two.
Nada de fiebre ni dolor de pecho, nada de eso. Solo cansada después de caminar.
El mes pasado tuve temperatura, pero se me quitó con los antibióticos y desde entonces bien.
Se me está cayendo el pelo otra vez, pero ya me dijeron que iba a pasar con este ciclo.
Tengo las piernas un poco adoloridas de caminar más, pero es un dolor bueno.
Mi esposo anda resfriado, así que he ido yo sola al mercado.
Esta semana me he sentido un poco bajoneada con tanta lluvia, pero ahí voy.
Las verduras están carísimas, ahora compro las congeladas.
Estaba preocupada por la bolita, pero el estudio salió limpio, gracias a Dios.
Hay días que no tengo ganas de cocinar y me como un sándwich.
Después de la quimio me queda un sabor metálico y el agua me sabe rara un par de días.
